severity_flags.label: Discrimination or harassment
severity_flags.description: The reviewer says they, or someone with them, were treated differently or badly because of race, ethnicity, language, religion, gender, sexuality, age, disability or similar; or were harassed, followed, profiled or humiliated by staff.

severity_flags.label: Staff misconduct
severity_flags.description: Staff behaved in a seriously improper way beyond poor service: theft, intoxication at work, physical aggression, verbal abuse, threats, recording customers, fraud or overcharging on purpose, or tampering with food or belongings.

severity_flags.label: Legal or regulatory threat
severity_flags.description: The reviewer threatens or reports legal action, a lawyer, a lawsuit, police, or a complaint to a health department, licensing board, consumer protection agency or similar regulator.

severity_flags.label: Threat of violence
severity_flags.description: The reviewer threatens to harm staff, the owner, customers or the property, or describes an intention to commit violence (including arson or vandalism).
